name: Spirit Rise
summary: On Thunder Bluff’s northwest mesa, Spirit Rise gathers shaman and seekers. The Skychaser tribe guides them above the Pools of Vision, where seers peer into spirit-touched waters.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Spirits
sections.body:
Spirit Rise crowns Thunder Bluff above the plains of Mulgore. Here, shaman seek communion with the elements and ancestor spirits. Rope bridges link the rise to the central mesa.

The Hall of Spirits and the Spiritual Healing pavilion draw young and veteran shaman alike. They come to deepen their bond with earth, air, fire, and water. The Skychaser tribe keeps a strong presence here and guides seekers in ancient traditions.

sections.title: Caves and Crossings
sections.body: Below the open-air totem shrines and huts, an entrance leads into the mesa. There, the steamy Pools of Vision fill a sacred cavern. Seers peer into waters touched by the spirits.

faq.q: What is Spirit Rise known for?
faq.answer: On Spirit Rise, shaman gather to practice, heal, and commune with nature spirits and ancestors. The rise also opens onto the Pools of Vision.

faq.q: Which tauren tribe leads activities on Spirit Rise?
faq.answer: The Skychaser tribe guides activity on Spirit Rise. Its members foster spiritual traditions, divination rituals, and shamanic training.

faq.q: What can I find underneath Spirit Rise?
faq.answer: A descent through Spirit Rise leads to the Pools of Vision. In the humid cavern, steaming waters draw seers and spiritual practitioners to meditate and seek visions.

angles.text: As a shaman of the Horde, you can come to Spirit Rise to consult trainers, perform elemental rites, and commune with ancestral spirits.
As a tauren, you find your people’s deep spiritual roots on the rise. Its quiet offers solace from secular duties, and the Pools of Vision lie below.
